sentences.text: Tuhin Subhra Das & Anr vs Unknown on 15 July, 2024

Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
15.07.2024 rc/ct.no.34 Item No.39 Crr No. 2465 of 2024 In the matter of : Tuhin Subhra Das &
Anr.
.......Petitioner Mr. Debasish Kar ...for the Petitioner

The petitioners seek quashing of proceedings of
G.R.Case No. 9456 of 2021 pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, 5th Court, Barrackpore
on the ground that there is no prima facie material against the petitioners under Sections 498A/34
of the Indian Penal Code either in the complaint or in the charge sheet.
The matter needs to be heard on merits.
The petitioners are directed to serve a copy of the application along with annexure thereto upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.
Let this matter appear under the heading "Contested Application" on September 06,2024.

Further proceedings of G.R.Case No. 9456 of 2021 pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, 5 th Court, Barrackpore be stayed till September 30, 2024 or until further orders whichever is earlier.

(Suvra Ghosh,J)
